title: Electrical safety
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Current through your body can burn you inside, upset your heart, and lock your hand onto a wire.
lines.label: current hurts

lines.caption: In a power cable, the black wire is hot. It carries the full 120 volts.
lines.label: black is hot

lines.caption: A fuse melts when too much current flows, and cuts the power before the wires can start a fire.
lines.label: cuts an overload

lines.caption: Even a 12 volt battery is dangerous. Metal across its terminals can cause burns, fire, or an explosion.
lines.label: never short it

lines.caption: And lightning gets a path to earth, through an arrester, before your feed line comes indoors.
lines.label: ground it outside
